findings.name: Three missable trophies
findings.detail: Who Needs Directions? (Mike Toreno mission), They Can't Stop All of Us (Black Project), Assassin (Madd Dogg's Rhymes). Missions are replayable via mission replay, but PowerPyx says 100% checklist has nothing missable for 100%.

findings.name: Cheats disable trophies

versionNotes.note: Xbox list is the same 34 achievements as PS minus the Platinum (no platinum on Xbox). Xbox gamerscore per GTABase/GTA Wiki: 34 entries totalling 1000 (GTABase lists values: 10,5,25,15,40,25,15,15,20,40,25,50,40,5,40,10,40,45,40,45,10,25,25,25,10,25,25,35,45,25,25,50,100,25). Total 35 on PS, 34 on Xbox.

Social Club has 13 additional 'accomplishments' (Sticky Fingers, 81 Years Too Late, Get a Pump, Beat the Cock, Metrosexual, Where'd He Go?, High As a Kite, Represent, Assert Yourself Next Time, Serial Offender, Freight Date, Time to Kill, Lots of Guns) that are NOT trophies/achievements. GTABase's '48' count includes them.
Per PowerPyx: no save transfer from original/other versions on PS4/PS5.
Switch/Switch 2 versions have no native trophies; PS list is the reference.

gaps: psnprofiles, truetrophies, trueachievements, playstationtrophies.org, gamerguides, progameguides all returned 403 or were not retrieved; PS list built from PowerPyx (tier totals, missables), GTABase and GTA Wiki (per-entry tiers). Descriptions came through a summarizing fetch, so wording may be lightly paraphrased; treat exact punctuation as unverified.
Per-trophy tiers rely on GTABase/GTA Wiki; they match PowerPyx totals 1/5/8/21 and the 4 Gold + 2 Bronze tiers PowerPyx names explicitly, but PS-specific tiers were not seen on a PS-native site.
Whether the game displays a completion percentage and other stat counters was not verified in this pass.
The 3 missable trophies: whether mission replay can re-earn them was not verified.
Differences in descriptions between Xbox and PS lists could not be checked on Xbox-native sites.
